summary: Dependency resolved from unpinned GitHub reference
details: package.json declares `libsignal-node` with the value `bellaxchuu/libsignal-node`, a GitHub shortcut rather than a registry version range. On `npm install`, npm fetches the current contents of that GitHub repository — with no commit SHA pin and no tarball integrity check — and executes any lifecycle scripts contained within it. The referenced repository is under the same GitHub account as the publisher of this package, so whoever controls that account controls code that runs on the installer's machine at install time, and can change that code at any moment without republishing this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
